citation.note: Pay-rate change notice required: Iowa Code § 91A.3 requires written notice of any change in pay rate at least 3 days before the change becomes effective.
Record Retention: Maintain all pay-rate-change notices, promotion records, and wage data for 4 years per § 91A.6.

Pay Frequency and Wage Notices: Iowa Code § 91A.3 does not mandate a specific pay frequency, but employers must establish regular paydays and notify employees in writing (at time of hiring and before any change) of:
Final pay timing mandated: Iowa Code § 91A.4 requires final wages paid by the next regular payday or within 5 days, whichever occurs first; fail to comply invokes civil penalty.

Failure to pay final wages timely triggers liquidated damages under Iowa Code § 91A.8: the employee may recover double the amount of unpaid wages plus attorney fees and costs.
Personnel-File Access (§ 91B.1): Model a 3-business-day response window for employee requests to access their personnel file (which includes pay history, promotions, performance notes).

Protected Classes under Chapter 216: Iowa Code Chapter 216 (Civil Rights Act) no longer covers gender identity as of SF 418 (effective 2025-07-01); sex, race, color, creed, national origin, disability, age remain protected.
